cohortRole: The original 40 PR17 records, already observed; not a new calibration cohort or untouched holdout.

statistics.median: ordinary median; average two central observations for even n
statistics.macro: unweighted average of per-record MAEs among records with observations
statistics.qualityDenominator: all 40 records; coverage additionally uses reference-eligible records

evaluationWindow: Per wave: first complete aggregate peak minus 150ms through last plus 150ms, clipped to analysis window. Out-of-window and incomplete-reference predictions are counted separately. No complete reference means unscored, not all false positives.
qrsDetection: All detectedPeaks, with delineation endpoints only when an actual beat candidate exists.
intervalReference: A unique P/T in the prespecified window; overlapping boundaries or multiple possibilities abstain. T offset must precede next QRS onset (or peak if onset missing) minus 20ms. This does not establish AV conduction.
reference: Unchanged fourLeadWaveReference (I/II/V1/V5) from PR26; aggregate is not an original human global annotation.
failureTriage: Numerical flags and reference QRS/rate only. Clinical causes require manual adjudication; flags are not diagnoses.
